headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on Mettler-Toledo Intl, Raises Price Target to $1450
summary: Morgan Stanley  analyst Kallum Titchmarsh   maintains Mettler-Toledo Intl (NYSE:MTD) with a Equal-Weight and raises the price target from $1275 to $1450.
